title: Deep Learning-Based IDS for Hybrid SDN
subtitle: Automated intrusion detection that ends alert fatigue in next-generation networks
description: An automated security system for hybrid software-defined networks that uses a CNN to cut false alarms by 99.9% and mitigate DDoS attacks in real time.
fullDescription:
This Honours thesis project tackles **alert fatigue** in Hybrid Software-Defined Networks (hSDN). Traditional security tools in these environments often flag legitimate traffic as malicious, generating thousands of false alarms that overwhelm security teams.

### The solution
I designed and built an automated Intrusion Detection System (IDS) integrated with an **OpenDaylight** controller. The system uses a **Convolutional Neural Network (CNN)** to analyse network traffic behaviour rather than relying on static signatures.

### Key engineering decisions
- **Baseline testing:** First implemented a traditional signature-based IDS, which failed with a **99.69% false positive rate**, establishing the need for a learned approach.
- **Live stress testing:** Validated the system in a **GNS3** testbed using **hping3** to generate novel, random DDoS attacks, showing that the model generalises to unseen threats rather than memorising a dataset.
- **Model selection:** Compared CNN and LSTM architectures. Selected the CNN because it was **7x faster to train** at equivalent accuracy, which matters for operational agility.
- **Operational logic:** Implemented a **20-second startup grace period** to filter unstable boot traffic and avoid false positives from pre-existing flows.

### Results
- **False alarms:** Reduced from **13,643** (baseline) to **5** (CNN model), a **0.04% false positive rate**.
- **Accuracy:** **99.98%** detection accuracy on live traffic.
- **Automation:** Fully automated detection-to-mitigation in **60 to 90 seconds**.

The project provides a validated blueprint for securing transitional hybrid networks with intelligent automation.

title: Goodies Store
subtitle: A responsive e-commerce storefront built with Vue.js 3
description: A single-page e-commerce application with live product data, a state-managed shopping cart and a responsive layout.
fullDescription:
Goodies Store is an e-commerce web application built as a Single Page Application (SPA) with Vue.js 3 and Vite. It demonstrates component-based architecture, state management and API integration.

### Key features
- **Product catalogue:** Products are fetched from a REST API (FakeStoreAPI) and displayed with loading states.
- **Shopping cart:** Powered by Pinia, the cart supports adding and removing items, running totals and state that persists across pages.
- **Routing:** Vue Router handles navigation between Home, Products, Cart, About and Contact.
- **Responsive design:** Built with CSS Grid and Flexbox for a consistent experience across devices.
- **Reusable components:** Shared header and footer components keep layout and navigation consistent.

title: Digit Recognition (ANN)
subtitle: A neural network trained on MNIST and tested on custom handwritten digits
description: An ANN in TensorFlow/Keras for handwritten digit classification: about 97.6% accuracy on MNIST and 60% on my own handwriting, a direct look at domain shift.
fullDescription:
This project develops an **Artificial Neural Network (ANN)** to recognise handwritten digits (0 to 9). The model was implemented in **TensorFlow/Keras** and trained on the **MNIST dataset** (60,000 training images, 10,000 test images).

### Part 1: Training on MNIST
- Preprocessed and normalised 28x28 grayscale digit images.
- Flattened images into 784-feature vectors.
- Built a 4-layer ANN with ReLU, Tanh, Sigmoid and Softmax activations.
- Achieved **about 97.6% accuracy** on the MNIST test set.

### Part 2: Testing on custom data
- Collected and preprocessed my own handwritten digit images (resized, grayscale, normalised).
- Evaluated the trained ANN on this dataset.
- Achieved **about 60% accuracy**, highlighting the effect of domain shift between real handwriting and MNIST.

### Key learnings
- The importance of **data preprocessing** (normalisation, resizing).
- How **activation functions, epochs and learning rate** affect performance.
- The need for **data augmentation** and more diverse training data to generalise.

### Future improvements
- Use a **Convolutional Neural Network (CNN)** for better feature extraction.
- Apply **data augmentation** (rotation, scaling, shifting).
- Collect a larger and more diverse custom dataset.

title: School Bus Monitoring System
subtitle: IoT-based real-time student safety and attendance tracking
description: An IoT school bus monitoring system using RFID, ESP32, GPS, Azure and Twilio SMS alerts to improve student safety and transport management.
fullDescription:
This project develops a monitoring system using RFID, an ESP32 microcontroller, GPS and Microsoft Azure to improve efficiency and child safety during school bus transport.

A bus unit detects students boarding and disembarking via RFID tags. The ESP32 collects this data and sends it to a Microsoft Azure server, which hosts a database and a web application for school administrators. Parents receive real-time SMS notifications via Twilio when their child boards or leaves the bus.

### Key features
- RFID-based student authentication and attendance tracking
- ESP32 microcontroller for data acquisition and communication
- GPS module for real-time bus location tracking
- Azure-hosted database and web application for administration
- Twilio SMS integration for instant parent notifications

The system was prototyped and tested, and shown to improve student safety, streamline bus operations and simplify attendance management.

title: Solar Charge Controller
subtitle: Arduino-based PWM solar charge controller for 12V lead-acid batteries
description: A microcontroller-driven PWM charge controller that safely charges a 12V lead-acid battery, with real-time monitoring and automatic overcharge protection.
fullDescription:
This project covers the design, simulation and build of a solar charge controller for a 12V lead-acid car battery. Charging uses Pulse Width Modulation (PWM), controlled by an Arduino Uno.

The Arduino measures voltage and current from the solar panel and the battery and generates a PWM signal to regulate charging. Charging stops automatically when the battery reaches 14.4V, the recommended full-charge voltage, and resumes when the voltage drops, preventing overcharging.

The circuit was first simulated in Tinkercad and then built as a physical prototype. An LCD shows battery voltage, charging current and charging status in real time. The prototype charged the battery to 14.4V and remained stable under varying conditions.

### Key features
- PWM-based charging control
- Automatic overcharge prevention at 14.4V
- Real-time voltage and current monitoring
- LCD display for user feedback
- Tinkercad simulation and physical prototype testing

title: ServiceMe Platform
subtitle: On-demand home services booking platform
description: A web application for booking cleaning and gardening services, with user accounts, provider profiles, booking management and payments.
fullDescription:
ServiceMe connects homeowners with service providers for house cleaning and gardening, with flows designed for both customers and providers.

### Key features
- **User accounts:** Customers and providers sign up and log in. Providers maintain profiles with their services, photos and descriptions.
- **Service booking:** Customers specify details such as number of rooms, garden size, date, time and location.
- **Provider selection:** Customers browse available providers, compare profiles, ratings and specialties, and choose one.
- **Billing and payments:** A billing page captures payment details and confirms the booking.
- **Notifications and feedback:** Customers receive confirmations, providers manage their schedules, and ratings help maintain quality.

Sign-up, login, booking, provider selection and billing workflows were all tested end to end and passed.

title: Connect Social Platform
subtitle: A Twitter-inspired social network with real-time interactions
description: A social networking platform where users create profiles, follow others and share posts in a live feed.
fullDescription:
Connect is a social networking platform modelled on the core features of Twitter. Users create accounts, manage profiles, follow and unfollow others, and share posts in a live feed.

### Key features
- **Authentication and validation:** Secure sign-up and login with validation for usernames, emails and passwords, and protection against duplicate accounts.
- **Profile management:** Users upload profile pictures and edit their bio and personal details.
- **Posting:** Posts appear instantly in the feed with timestamps, usernames and avatars.
- **Following:** The feed updates to show posts only from followed users.
- **Search:** Find users by name or username and follow them directly from the results.

The platform uses JSP, Servlets and MySQL for backend logic and persistence, with AJAX and jQuery for dynamic interactions.
